# Command reference

Investigate Tenable One exposure and run explicitly guarded writes.
Run each command with `--help` for concise help.
Writes default to preview and require configured operation scope even for previews.

## asset list

Search assets

Operation: `inventory-assets-search`.

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default credential precedence |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default credential precedence |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated display or wire properties; default compact view |
| `--full` | Show full text; default false |
| `--help` | Show help |
| `--limit` | Maximum emitted rows, 1-10000; default 100 |
| `--all` | Read up to 10000 rows within invocation budgets; excludes --limit |
| `--cursor` | Opaque resume cursor; retain the original selectors and filters |
| `--query` | Simple query text |
| `--filter` | Repeatable: <property> <operator> <JSON string array> |
| `--filter-file` | JSON flat array of {property, operator, value: string[]}; '-' reads stdin; excludes --filter |
| `--sort` | Wire property:asc\|desc |
| `--extra-properties` | Comma-separated extra wire properties |
| `--offset` | Starting record; default 0; excludes --cursor |
| `--class` | Server-side asset class filter |

```sh
tenable-axi asset list --limit 20
tenable-axi asset list --query example
```

## asset show

Find one asset by exact ID search

Operation: `inventory-assets-search`.

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|

| `--profile` | Profile name; default credential precedence |

## attack-path list

Search top attack paths using the published specification route

Operation: `apa-attack-paths-search`.

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default credential precedence |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default credential precedence |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated display or wire fields; default compact view |
| `--full` | Show full text; default false |
| `--help` | Show help |
| `--limit` | Maximum emitted rows, 1-10000; default 100 |
| `--all` | Read up to 10000 rows within invocation budgets; excludes --limit |
| `--cursor` | Bounded resume cursor; retain original selectors, filters, sort and fields |
| `--offset` | Starting record; default 0; excludes --cursor |
| `--sort` | Documented wire property:direction |
| `--filter` | Repeatable: <property> <operator> <JSON-value>; combines with AND (paths) or and (techniques) |
| `--filter-file` | Documented single or nested JSON filter, at most two logical levels; '-' reads stdin; excludes --filter |
| `--include-resolved` | Include resolved records; default false (exclude_resolved=true) |
| `--run-ai-summarization` | true\|false; default false |

```sh
tenable-axi attack-path list --limit 20
tenable-axi attack-path list --filter 'priority gte 8' --include-resolved
```

## export asset start

Preview or create an inventory asset export job

Operation: `inventory-export-assets`.

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default platform path |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default credential precedence |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated output fields; default compact view |
| `--full` | Full output; default false |
| `--help` | Show help |
| `--body-file` | Optional strict query/filters JSON file, '-' for stdin; maximum 1 MiB |
| `--properties` | Comma-separated names from asset properties; id maps to asset_id |
| `--use-readable-name` | true\|false; API default true |
| `--max-chunk-file-size` | 5242880-104857600 bytes; API default 20971520 |
| `--sort` | property:asc\|desc |
| `--file-format` | JSON\|CSV; API default JSON |
| `--compress` | true\|false; API default false |
| `--execute` | Create once; default preview |
| `--dry-run` | Explicit preview; excludes --execute |
| `--confirm` | Exact confirmation from preview |
| `--intent-id` | Unique execution intent for replay protection |

```sh
tenable-axi export asset start --body-file scope.json
tenable-axi export asset start --body-file scope.json --execute --confirm <confirmation>
```
